{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the unique values in 'site'
print("Unique sites:", df['site'].unique())

# Check the value counts for 'site'
print("\nSite counts:\n", df['site'].value_counts())

# Check the value counts for 'responded'
print("\nResponse counts:\n", df['responded'].value_counts())

# Compute response rate by site
response_rates = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean() * 100
print("\nResponse rates by site (%):\n", response_rates)"}
